ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.13 changes the Job-search optimization from request-time main-thread assistance to true background precomputation. Repeated IList-backed custom GenClosest searches can now snapshot Thing references and integer positions, build immutable spatial indexes on RimMT worker cores at normal priority, and reuse those indexes on later JobGiver calls without waiting for a worker. Every accelerated call first proves that the published snapshot still matches the live source list exactly; any membership or position change falls back to Vanilla and schedules a rebuild. Live Reachability.CanReach, WorkGiver validators, reservations and final Jobs remain main-thread authoritative. Exact ListerHaulables searches still use the dedicated V0.4.6/V0.4.7 accelerators. Bounded path shadow validation, V0.4.8 slow JobPackage tracing and Butter++ logical-tick barriers are retained. The performance priority remains: reduce visible stutter first, then improve TPS.
